map.15×15 棋盘（225 个交叉点），黑白轮流落子，横/竖/斜任意方向先连成 5: A 15x15 board (225 intersections), black and white play in turn, and the first to make 5 in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins; an open four (four in a row with both ends empty) cannot be blocked on both sides at once so it is a forced win. The simplified version has no forbidden moves, so the first player (black) has a clear advantage. ...
map.双人对战：在 15×15 标准棋盘轮流落子，先连成五子者胜。: Two-player match: place stones in turn on a standard 15x15 board, first to five in a row wins.
map.AI 练习：单人挑战启发式 AI，练进攻与防守。: AI practice: challenge the heuristic AI solo and practise attack and defence.
map.算法演示：理解活四、活三、冲四等棋型评估，适合讲解博弈搜索。: Algorithm demonstration: understand evaluation of shapes such as open four, open three and rush four, suitable for explaining game search.
map.无禁手规则下黑棋先手且可抢中心，优势大；后手宜早做活三牵制、避免被冲四: With no forbidden moves, black moves first and can take the centre, a large advantage; the second player should build an open three early to constrain and avoid being hit by rush fours
